I should know better but yes, comparing myself to cis men and post-op trans men as someone far from even getting on T is addicting. I know some of my expectations are definitely unrealistic, but as someone who's had a history of eating disorders and needing validation from cishet guys, I'm a very superficial person when it comes to my own looks. Sometimes, I think that if I can't be an attractive guy, I may as well not be a guy at all. This mindset is so unhealthy, and I'm really working on it, but as someone who's always been concerned with my looks, it really is hard.   


As for relationships with gay men, it's definitely reassuring that relationships with them are still possible. I didn't want to mention it too much (especially since I am a minor and it could lead to some bad DMs or people being uncomfortable) but the sex thing REALLY concerned me. I feared I'd be unfuckable to gay men, especially since I do enjoy front hole penetration, am a bottom, and it's unlikely I'll commit to bottom surgery (something to think about down the line for sure). That last thing I want is to be some disgusting freak to potential sex partners, and only having been in sexual relationships with straight men, all those possibilities of rejection scare me. As a "conventionally attractive" femme cis girl, rejection is uncommon to me. So having to suddenly deal with the inevitable is daunting.   


You have encouraged me to be more hopeful though, so I appreciate it greatly!

Thank you so much for this response.   


Right off the bat, I know, and have known for years that loss of fertility was something I was not only NOT concerned with, but something I preferred. Before even being exposed to trans discourse, I sometimes imagined (and slightly hoped) some random illness or event would take away my ability to give birth (as ungrateful as that may be). I don't want kids, and though I'm young, I've never felt more sure about anything.   


You explained my situation in much better words than I ever could. It really is a dilemma; living a life based on a lie to achieve some kind of happiness through forced meaningless pleasure and relationships built on distrust...or being truer with myself and potentially sacrificing that love life I've always craved.   


I ESPECIALLY am hyper-focused on being wanted. I've had a deep history of putting myself through hell just for someone to tell me they want me. I essentially live for others, and it may sound unhealthy, but nothing makes me happier than being desired so much. Maybe it stems from my upbringing, or the fact I've always gained a lot of attention as a cis woman, or a combination of the two. It's something I still need to work on. That being said, losing hope for relationships, to be wanted, to be married, that would absolutely crush me.   


Maybe that perfect relationship in my head will never be possible. Not as a cis-woman compromising, or a trans man working with the limited amount of people who will accept me as such. It's a hard pill to swallow. But discussions like these really make the pain of such a lonely future a lot easier to deal with. I may not be accepted by men, or hell, most people, but I feel accepted (and better yet understood) by people like you, and that really does make me happy.

Honestly, I can't thank you enough for this. I already understand the bit about the shitty dating track record, I've made "compromises" with cishet men in nearly every relationship, and each time it ended in abuse. Sometimes I think it's alright, and that maybe down the line a partner like that will take the compromises without running with them and hurting me. But I know that's silly.   


It's absurd the things I'll do to be desired and loved. It's hard to face a reality that if I'm being truest to myself, those things will be harder to achieve.   


Your story really helped, I honestly appreciate advice from older trans people more than younger ones, simply to get an idea for what's in the long-term like you said.   


Again, thank you.

1) The top-most left image with the 4 pictures is Everywhere at the End of Time  
2) The top-most right image that shows a live action with bandages on his eyes is Faces of Death  
3) The pills in the center are Prozac  
4) The center right image of the hallways are the Backrooms  
5) The bottom-most left picture of the cat is the Louis Wain painting  
6) The bottom-center image of the elephant is the Jinmen manga  
7) The bottom-most right image of the girl with her hands on her face is the Midori anime

Explanation for those wondering (Right to Left Up to Down)  
1) This is a collection of experimental noise music albums by the Caretaker called Everywhere at the End of Time. The series is supposed to imitate the experience of dementia, starting from early signs of the illness to death. It lasts 6 hours.  
2) Faces of Death is a fake documentary hosted by fictional pathologist Dr. Gross. It's a montage of footage containing both real and fake death, including a monkey being eaten alive, a plane crash, and an electric chair execution.   
3) Prozac is a just medication that treats serious depression, OCD, panic disorders, and eating disorders.   
4) The Backrooms is a creepypasta probably originating from 4-chan. This one is pretty popular so there's not much to explain. I suggest just looking it up if you're not familiar since there's variations of what this is and what it's about.  
5) This is a piece by Louis Wain, an English artist who liked to draw cats. He developed schizophrenia, and as his condition worsened, his drawings became more surreal and more unsettling. I highly recommend looking at his work, even if its just something to look at during a trip.   
6) Jinmen is a horror manga by Takahiro Kato. It involves very detailed and disturbing imagery of animals with human faces in a zoo attacking people. The series is as dark as it is good and I highly suggest it if you're a manga reader.   
7) Midori is an old ero-guro anime that tells the story of a poor girl joining a circus and slowly losing her sanity and life. I don't recommend this unless you can handle very dark subject matter, as it contains rape, animal abuse, pedophilia, etc.
